notes.title: Tutorial update!
notes.content: A lot of small updates and fixes, but the biggest change for this update is the tutorial now includes a couple steps to ensure players understand the core controls.

notes.title: Skybox Texture Update
notes.content: This update adds a nice skybox to gameplay, improving the look and feel of the game quite a bit.  The Main menu background has also been updated to match latest art style changes.

notes.title: Small Graphics Update!
notes.content:
Graphics Update!
New animations added for:
* Projectile Impacts
* Mob Regeneration
* Mob Damage Resistance

A bug was found and fixed for large belt lines.
+Misc fixes around steam achievements.

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
Just some minor fixes this time:

1. Fixes a menu tooltip bug that would recommend the wrong structure to create something.
2. Fixes a chance for items to suddenly become huge.
3. Increase the velocity of items coming out of coal smelters.
4. Adding a creative mode factory for creative players.

notes.title: Hotfix corner belts
notes.content:
Thanks for reporting the bugs!
This fixes a corner belt failure caused by a previous change.

notes.title: Hotfix for belt stagger
notes.content: A belt stagger got introduced by a last-minute change that made it past testing.  Should now be fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix for routers after performance update.
notes.content: Performance update broke the router output.  This should fix it.

notes.title: Last big update for playtest?
notes.content:
This is the biggest and likely the last big update for the playtest!

There are now 6 tiers of technology and resources, many UI improvements like right-clicking to cancel individual queued items, and displays on buildings to let you know what recipe has been assigned.

Huge thanks to everyone who participated in this playtest and sent me their feedback.  This update brings the factory side of the game very close to our final intentions for early access.  The next step will be to iterate and improve on the tower defense aspect of the game as well as adding polishes like Steam Achievements, ambient sounds, and special effects.

Please continue to play this update for the next week or so and provide your feedback.  Looking forward to getting the full game out to everyone soon!

notes.title: Turret Animation added
notes.content:
Fixed the sliders on sound and music to be easier to use.
Added an animation for arrow turrets so they have some action while shooting at creeps.

notes.title: Main character visual update!
notes.content:
Changes for this build:

1. This build updates the art for the main character and a few other pieces. 
2. There are also a lot of new sounds added to the game.  
3. Tutorial fixes
4. Bug fixes

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Game Art!
notes.content:
Thank you to @saurav_kumar_72 on Discord for working with me to create better art for Automate Defend Repeat.  Up until this point, I've been sole developer and artist for this game, and I'm only decent at one of those two skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487415/b5aa946d1f299bdd73f88f5c5347cdc1629711c9.png

The game still has a long ways to go, but I hope you all find it more pleasant to play now. 

Other updates/fixes:
1. Improvements to how routers and junctions work
2. Early prototype of a mini-map in the top left of the game view
3. Bug fixes for tower defense mobs
4. Life bars added to tower defense mobs. 

Still a ways to go, looking forward to your feedback.  Please drop by the discord channel and say hi and let me know what you think of the game.

Thanks,
Josh.
